notes.title: New Release! Get ZHive for $1.79 (-40%)
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone

We have launched another wallet friendly game...Zhive!

Zhive is a small and simple strategy game where you command the undead on the map by selecting the areas where you want them to spawn and then direct them to a target area. But be careful, think strategically. The soldiers are well equipped and can decimate your minions with ease. Don't let them roam around, they could restock and find the survivor!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33017571/110f5f3f7069ae9cbfabe596cf19ef9930b577e5.gif[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1119530/ZHIVE/

notes.title: New Release! Get ORC RAID for $3.50 [30% launch discount]
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone.

We have released a new game! Orc Raid is a first person shooter where you fight tons enemies coming at you. It features a small story mode and the classic survival mode to rank via online leaderboards. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1061160/Orc_Raid/

While this time, the game sports a more fantasy like world, It still contains our signature content..... :)

It has..... explosions!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33017571/71cb013290e5707c581fc4203819c411be089493.gif[/img]

It has..... flying bodyparts!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33017571/61236771fd050adb7ed10bdb9f6baf6bd972b973.gif[/img]

It has.... blood splashing everywhere!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33017571/1f4a1404ae5e619b318cb7b7f60e51df5edc5e3c.gif[/img]

Did I mention it has flying bodyparts?
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33017571/94e75d5eceaa76fac2dfd5dc00c02fd2b16c7caa.gif[/img]

We hope you can support us with your purchase so we can keep raising the quality bar so one day, we can produce a game that will forever be remembered. 

Thanks for playing!

notes.title: New Game! "Dragon Chase" is now available! [30% Off]
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone

We present you another wallet friendly game!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33017571/12778fd3b1a12f568afb01ab807460b43d6f7ab3.gif[/img]

Dragon chase is a small game hybrid between a platformer and a runner where you take the control of a knight being chased by a Dragon. Avoid being ripped by the Dragon, dodge traps and fend off enemies on a randomized environment.

Dragon Chase is available for just 2 dollars and currently has a launch discount of 30%. We recommend you to get Dragon Chase if you would like to enjoy a quick challenge. We hope you can support us with your purchase.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1011240/Dragon_Chase/

notes.title: Happy Autumn Sale! and check out a new game!
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone!

We wish you a happy autumn sale and that you buy so many games that you won't be able to finish them this lifetime :)

In other news, we have released another wallet friendly game! [b]Time Splatter is available for $0.60[/b]..... But what is a Time Splatter? How do you eat it? [gif below]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33017571/674882d078679411cffcc2fc5a98ec15d7ef96f2.gif[/img]

Time splatter is a small episodic rail shooter game where our protagonist, after touching an ancient monolith, is transported to the times where the black plague transformed people into zombie like creatures and knights protected the land. [Another gif below....]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33017571/80c380c8f250ef2aa122d59203415ba09b79edf5.gif[/img]

At launch, only chapter 1 will be available, but we plan to release two more chapters... for free. If the game does well, there are concepts for another three, but lets not get ahead hehe. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/949530/Time_Splatter/

We hope you can support us with your purchase and keep helping us making games. We are hoping to step up the level of our games and bring you better and larger experiences early next year. But you, mighty players are the ones that will make this possible with your purchases and reviews. 

Check out our other games.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/904130/Defense_Abominations/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/846010/Visceral_Cubes/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/649450/Deadly_Escape/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/618610/Endless_Horde/

As always thanks for playing!

PD. We just sorted a couple problems we had that made development difficult. Expect to see content updates for several games soon.

notes.title: SUMMER SALE 66% OFF! & UPDATE #12
notes.notes:
[h1]Endless Horde v2.5.12 is now online! [/h1]

Happy Summer sale! 
We bring you a small but no less important update. 

[h1]New features/Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]New Explosion VFX.[/b] We are experimenting on giving better vfx to the game. For now you can check out a new explosion vfx.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28340092/4e20f7f9e574a7c21853cc62ca5c663d61005524.gif[/img]

[*][b]Switching Minimap.[/b] You can now press TAB to change the position of the minimap.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28340092/0dc7115db235574e8faf3d923586ce035ba36e19.gif[/img]

[*][b]Top Players.[/b] The top players of the leaderboard are now displayed in the main menu.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28340092/45c3c6e82785bb8e241312820b0945fa5043f7c3.jpg[/img]

[*][b]Supply Boxes.[/b] Along with the scientists, a black box will spawn. If you repair it, it will automatically pickup the supply and experience pickups. There is one per spawn and can get destroyed by the zombies.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28340092/3cc8a01978d90b8af8b52b0999be916e89473e10.gif[/img]

 [*][b]Balancing Changes[/b] Repair now only costs 100 supplies
    

[/list]

[h1]Incoming New Stuff[/h1]
[list]
[*]Performance increase for the undead. Will cause less glitchy AI behavior.
[*]Help about the boom button and its shortcut key being displayed at the pause menu.
[*]Separating the "repair" into an extra slot so you don't have to equip it.

[/list]
[h1]Words from the devs[/h1]
[list]
[*]Sorry for the lack of updates! as you all know, indie sales on steam are decreasing at an alarming rate. With less budget, less updates for long time released games. We are hoping to get a good injection of budget thanks to the summer sale and bring you cool stuff in the future. Meanwhile, if you see stuff dissapearing from the incoming list, its because it was cancelled.

[*]Enjoy summer sale!
[/list]

As always, thanks for your support!

notes.title: Update Coming Soon. Check out Zombie Desperation, 40% off!
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone

There will be an update soon that will incorporate one or two new features based in the feedback from the forums. But for now, we wanted to tell everyone to check out Zombie Desperation, another wallet friendly game. [b]For a limited time 40% off, you can get it for....... $0.60![/b]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32262387/4f469a1c2ea5e7efd2425a0f0ef4ce360a75946e.gif[/img]

Just like Endless Horde, Zombie Desperation also has a leaderboard where the players have been struggling for the top spots. Can the Endless Horde community overtake them? Looking forward to see that. You can see a small video of the game down here. Wherever you are interested in the game or you just wish to support us with you 60¢ to help us keep making games, we will be really grateful for your purchase.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/818570/Zombie_Desperation/

As always thank you for your support!

notes.title: UPDATE #11
notes.notes:
[h1]Endless Horde v2.4 is now online! [/h1]

The facility has been overrun! [b]push the red button![/b] to destroy all enemies!
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28340092/0feae19166f2c839ef9bbfc1f0e2826b81a69af9.gif[/img]

[h1]New features/Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Boom Button.[/b]  Destroys all enemies on the map. It has a cooldown of 3 seconds per enemy killed. Good to speed up during early waves and to get out of dangerous situations during late waves. Shortcut key: B
[*][b]Balancing changes.[/b] The money generated per wave and exp per pickup has been increased to diminish grinding required to unlock units.
    

[/list]

[h1]Incoming New Stuff[/h1]
[list]
[*]Performance increase for the undead. Will cause less glitchy AI behavior.
[*]Survivors Log. In this section, the best players of the previous year will be displayed.
[*]Help about the boom button and its shortcut key being displayed at the pause menu.

[/list]
[h1]Words from the devs[/h1]
[list]
[*]The "invincible" undead bug was fixed weeks ago with a small patch.
[*]We will be deleting a couple bug threads whose bugs have been fixed and so we will create a main bugs thread. Don't hesitate to post anything you find.
[*]Join our new group! Once we gather enough members we'll give away cool stuff. [url=http://steamcommunity.com/groups/ominousgaminggroup]Join us!
[*]As always, if you liked the game and would like us to keep updating it with new stuff. Don't hesitate to help us with a review to keep the game going.
[/list]

And as always, thanks for your support!

notes.title: UPDATE #10
notes.notes:
Endless Horde v2.2.4 is now online! 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28340092/b9c851b3f02f851024d0aca08bb7208e5418c841.gif[/img]

[h1]New features/Improvements[/h1]
[list]
    [*][b]Acid Barrels.[/b] Acid barrels have been placed in the map as part of the default map defenses

    [*][b]Minor Changes.[/b] Fixed some typos and made several optimizations 
       here and there.

notes.title: HALLOWEEN SALE! 40% off and new update!
notes.notes:
We hope you have a happy Halloween sale!

Endless Horde v2.2 is now online!
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28340092/dbf1d343cd2067fddd71233d49fec0eb7472bf80.gif[/img]

[h1]New features/Improvements[/h1]
[list]
    [*][b]Map Defenses.[/b] Turrets and some guards have been placed in the maps to help the player fend off the hordes during the early waves.
    [*][b]Gameplay Tips.[/b] New gameplay tips were added to the loading screen

[/list]

[h1]Incoming stuff[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]More Map Defenses[/b]
[*][b]New achievements.[/b]
[*][b]New Units.[/b]
[/list]

[h1]Words from the devs[/h1]

[list]
[*]We want to apologize for the late update and the delay of Deadly Escape's release. With hurricanes in the north and earthquakes in the south, some of our devs got affected. Nothing serious but enough to cause delays.
[*]As always, if you liked the game, don't hesitate to write a review. We plan to update this game for a long long time, your reviews are always helpful.
[*]Don't hesitate to post about any bug you may find! 
[/list]

And as always, thanks for your support!

    [*][b]Two new maps.[/b] Based on the upcoming [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=868850872]Deadly Escape[/url], new maps are now playable. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28340092/2f16fbf1739558f08b125c52807bd4cb4e7fb463.jpg[/img]

    [*][b]Small bug fixes.[/b]

[list]
[*][b]New achievements.[/b]
[*][b]Gameplay Balancing.[/b] Some of the new updates have made the game too easy. 
[*][b]Multi-Language support.[/b]
[*][b]New Units.[/b]
[/list]

[h1]Words from the devs[/h1]

[list]
[*]We wish you a happy summer sale shopping!
[*]If you are enjoying the game, [b]please consider writing a review.[/b] They help us maintain the game and our other projects.
[*]With big changes, new bugs could appear, don't forget to post them at the forums so we can fix them!
[*]If you are still experiencing the resolution bug, please post on [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/618610/discussions/0/133261907144541194]this thread[/url] and we'll get in contact with you
[*]We'll re-balance the game soon!
[*]Apologies for the late update!


[/list]

And as always, thanks for your support!

notes.notes:
[h1]New features/Improvements[/h1]
[list]
    [*][b]Placement Grid Update.[/b] The grid used to place units is now more accurate. Fixes several bugs like units overlapping.
    [*][b]Skip Preparation Phase.[/b] During the preparation phase (GET READY), you can now click the counter for the wave to begin
    [*][b]Volume Options Fix.[/b] The values of the music/SFX values have been fixed, the lowest volume possible will now be lower.
    [*][b]Barrel Fixes.[/b] Fixed several bugs related to the barrels and also made them more efficient. 
[/list]

notes.title: UPDATE #3
notes.notes:
[h1]Endless Horde v1.0.3[/h1]

[h1]New features/Improvements[/h1]

[list]
    [*][b]Steam Trading Cards[/b]
    [*][b]Minimap[/b] Toggle with M, you can also click on it for the camera to 
                      move over that area.
    [*][b]Speed up button[/b]. Once every undead has spawned during that wave, the speed up button will become available. It makes the undead become faster for that impatient, yet skillful player. Careful, could result in game over. Not recommended for early waves or lower level players.
    [*][b]Increased EXP per wave[/b]
    [*][b]Increased supplies spawn rate[/b]
[/list]

[h1]Incoming Features[/h1]
[list]
    [*][b]Multi-Language support[/b]
    [*][b]Improvements to the minimap[/b]

[h1]Bugs to be fixed[/h1]
[list]
    [*][b]Resolution bug[/b]. See day 1 update for more info on this.
     [*][b]Several other small bugs[/b]
[/list]

[h1]Message from the devs[/h1]

It is time to start working on new content, don't hesitate to post your awesome ideas in the forums. 

If you have time to spare, please consider writing a review of Endless Horde.
It would greatly help us to maintain the game alive in the future!

Thanks!
